sentences.text: Rejoinder affidavit has been filed today in Court which is taken on record.

Heard learned counsel for the applicant and learned counsel for the opposite party along with learned A.G.A.
This anticipatory bail application (under section 438 Cr.P.C.) has been moved seeking bail in Case Crime No. 285 of 2021, under sections 419, 420, 467, 468 and 471 I.P.C., Police Station- Machhalishahar, District- Jaunpur.
It is submitted in this case that applicant is innocent and has committed no offence.

He is said to be marginal witness in the sale-deed alleged to be executed by imposter (Jhallar) who was identified by Rakesh Singh vs State Of U.P. And Another on 22 May, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/113937542/
1

sentences.text: the present applicant as real owner Radhey Shyam (informant).
It is also submitted that the amount was received by Dhirendra Kumar, who is an Advocate and applicant identified the vendor at the instance of Dhirendra Kumar.
He is not real beneficiary and now after investigation, charge-sheet has been filed by the I.O. and he is under apprehension of arrest, therefore, requested for anticipatory bail.

Learned counsel for the opposite party as well as learned A.G.A. have opposed the prayer as aforesaid and urged that in this case, the land belonging to the informant was transferred in favour of Ravati Chandra for receiving Rs. 4,80,000/- as consideration and sale-deed was executed by standing imposter (Jhallar) on the place of informant Radhey Shaym and that fictitious person was identified by the present applicant as real one and informant was deprived of his ownership of the land on account of the present applicant and other co-accused persons.
In this way he cannot said to be entitled for anticipatory bail.

Considering the facts and circumstances of the case, submissions made by learned counsel for the parties as well as learned A.G.A., perusal of record and without making any comment on the merit of the case, there appears no ground to grant anticipatory bail in favour of the applicant.
Accordingly, the anticipatory bail application is, hereby, rejected.

Order Date :- 22.5.2023 M.S. Ansari  Rakesh Singh vs State Of U.P. And Another on 22 May, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/113937542/
